sections.title: Historic Preservation Capstone Studio
sections.description: The Graduate Program in Historic Preservation's Capstone Studio course is a one-semester 2 CU course taken instead of HSPV 710/711 Thesis to fulfill the MSHP capstone requirement. This is a research studio that builds on the core curriculum completed in the first year. The work requires intense collaboration as well as individual projects. A studio topic will be chosen and announced each year.
